known_gap_proven_live.cause: exactly-once is per serverless instance (in-memory set); the payments log file is not writable on Vercel's read-only filesystem, so a replay that lands on a different instance is not blocked. This was documented as a limit before the live proof; the proof confirmed it.
known_gap_proven_live.evidence: the same payment tx hash was presented again for a different valid action (mint genesis-visitor-9) and passed the dedup check — the payment was re-verified and the executor attempted the mint. It failed only on treasury balance (0.2014 NEAR available, 0.6 needed), not on dedup.
known_gap_proven_live.issue: cross-instance replay is NOT blocked on Vercel
known_gap_proven_live.mitigations_in_place: the executor is idempotent per token (birth/breed are skipped when the agent already exists, so the same token cannot be double-minted); action pre-validation; a replay for a different action still needs the treasury to fund it.
known_gap_proven_live.proper_fix: a shared store (Vercel KV or an onchain payment registry) — needs Isaiah's decision
